extract_notes: skip: microcosm/spiked experiment — forest soil from Mt. Dabie (Hubei) placed in 150-mL serum bottles and spiked with 13C-labeled PHE/ANT/FLT at 10 mg/kg to identify PAH-degrading bacteria via DNA-SIP. No field sampling-point level OP concentration data. Table 1 reports degradation residual percentages (not real-site concentrations); Table 2 reports 16S rRNA clone library taxa. No pre-remediation baseline. Cited forest soil PAH ranges (4.6-350, 0.7-65, 6.8-890 ug/kg) are from references [18,19], not measured in this study.
